preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the rebase() function with a large multiple value (e.g., type(uint256).max / currentRebaseMultiple + 1) to cause an overflow in the multiplication at line 338 (rebaseMultiple * multiple). This will make rebaseMultiple become 0, breaking all token arithmetic since division by zero will revert. Alternatively, use a multiple that causes rebaseMultiple to become extremely large, making token transfers fail due to overflow in amount * rebaseMultipl calculations.
